---
title: "Referencing a SQL Listing with a ggplot"
format: html
---

## Setup

First, we load the required packages and prepare a small dataset in R.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(ggplot2)

# Create an in-memory DuckDB and register a data frame
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb("./database.db"))
```

## The Analysis

The following listing shows the SQL query and a plot of its results.
See @lst-time-series-donations for the full details.



#### time-series-donations
::: {#lst-time-series-donations}


```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| code-fold: true
drop table mart.time_series_donations;

create table mart.time_series_donations as
SELECT
  donations.transaction_date,
  committee.committee_name,
  sum(donations.transaction_amount) AS amount
FROM
  mart.donations AS donations
  LEFT JOIN mart.committee AS committee
    ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
    ON committee.internal_id = cc_linkage.committee_key
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
    ON cc_linkage.candidate_key = candidate.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.contributors AS contributors
    ON donations.contributor_key = contributors.internal_id
WHERE
  (
    candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%behn%'
    OR candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
    OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%unrigged%'
    OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
  )
  AND (
    donations.transaction_date BETWEEN (
      '2025-12-02'::DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    ) AND '2025-12-02'::DATE
  )
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  amount desc;


```


```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| echo: false

select * from mart.time_series_donations;
 
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Aggregate USD amount by week"
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart showing daily USD expenditures for Epps vs Behn "

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "
                pivot mart.time_series_donations
                on committee_name
                using first(amount)
                order by transaction_date desc
")

# Most basic bubble plot
p <- ggplot(
  data = subset(result, !is.na(`MATT VAN EPPS FOR CONGRESS`)),
  aes(x = transaction_date)
) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .data[['MATT VAN EPPS FOR CONGRESS']],
                color = 'MATT VAN EPPS FOR CONGRESS')) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .data[['UNRIGGED PAC']],
                color = 'UNRIGGED PAC')) +
  labs(y = "Amount (USD)")
p
```

**Listing:** A SQL query that aggregates the amount of USD spent in the Epps vs Behn race for the week of 2025-12-02 order by greatest to least transaction , along with its resulting time series chart.


:::





#### ranked state donations

::: {#lst-ranked-state-donation}

```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| code-fold: true
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mart.ranked_states;

CREATE TABLE mart.ranked_states AS
WITH ranking AS (
  SELECT
    contributors.state,
    committee.committee_name,
    sum(donations.transaction_amount) AS amountUSD,
    count(*) AS donations_count
  FROM
    mart.donations AS donations
    LEFT JOIN mart.committee AS committee
      ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
    LEFT JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
      ON committee.internal_id = cc_linkage.committee_key
    LEFT JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
      ON cc_linkage.candidate_key = candidate.internal_id
    LEFT JOIN mart.contributors AS contributors
      ON donations.contributor_key = contributors.internal_id
  WHERE
    (
      candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%behn%'
      OR candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
      OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%unrigged%'
    )
    AND (
      donations.transaction_date
      BETWEEN ('2025-12-02'::DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND '2025-12-02'::DATE
    )
  GROUP BY
    ALL
)

SELECT
  *,
  dense_rank()
    OVER (PARTITION BY committee_name ORDER BY amountUSD DESC)
    AS amountUSD_rank,
  dense_rank()
    OVER (PARTITION BY committee_name ORDER BY donations_count DESC)
    AS donations_count_rank
FROM
  ranking
ORDER BY
  amountUSD_rank;

```

```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| echo: false
select * from mart.ranked_states
order by amountUSD desc;

```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Aggregate USD amount by week"
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart showing daily USD expenditures for Epps vs Behn "

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "
           from mart.ranked_states
           where 
           amountUSD_rank <= 15
           order by state;
        ")

# Most basic bubble plot
ggplot(result, aes(fill=.data[['committee_name']],x=reorder(.data[['state']], -.data[['amountUSD']]), y=.data[['amountUSD']])) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip()
```



A SQL query that aggregates the amount of USD spent in the Epps vs Behn race by state ranked donations , along with its resulting bar chart.

:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
